changes: Still Launcher is now Glyph. The included keyboard appears as Glyph Keyboard in Android settings.
Type a comma from the letter keyboard using the key beside Backspace. The apostrophe stays on the space-bar row.
Glyph installs as a separate app from Still Launcher. Set Glyph as your home app and re-enable Glyph Keyboard if you use it. Your old layout and settings stay in Still Launcher.
